user_visible_response:
I understand the request as a tiny browser-only static quote board project named `codexa-private-01-quote-board-1780176174` in the current project directory. It will use only `index.html`, `styles.css`, `script.js`, and `README.md`, with favorites saved locally in the browser, likely via `localStorage`. No backend, auth, database, build step, deployment, or payment/integration work is included.

Plan:
1. Create the static app shell and README.
2. Build the quote board UI with a small curated quote set, favorite toggles, a favorites view/filter, and empty/error-safe states.
3. Persist favorite quote IDs in `localStorage` so favorites survive reloads.
4. Add lightweight polish for responsive browser use.
5. Run local validation such as file existence checks and JavaScript syntax validation.
6. Record any non-blocking bugs, UX ideas, optimizations, or test gaps in `.head-developer/IMPROVEMENTS.md` without expanding scope.

Validation will include executable checks like `test -f index.html`, `test -f styles.css`, `test -f script.js`, `test -f README.md`, and `node --check script.js`.

Approve this plan and Codex can start one local Codex CLI implementation session.
requirements_summary: Create a new tiny static quote board app in the existing project path named codexa-private-01-quote-board-1780176174. Browser-only implementation using index.html, styles.css, script.js, and README.md. Favorite quotes must be saved locally in the browser. Include local validation, concise progress updates, and continuous-improvement tracking in .head-developer/IMPROVEMENTS.md. No backend, auth, database, deployment, build tooling, or integrations unless later approved.
assumptions: Favorites are persisted with browser localStorage.
Quotes can be a small curated static dataset embedded in script.js.
The app should run by opening index.html directly in a browser; no dev server is required.
Continuous-improvement notes are documented but not implemented if they would expand scope.
proposed_design: A single-page static quote board with a responsive grid/list of quote cards. Each card shows quote text, author, and a favorite control. A simple toolbar allows switching between all quotes and favorites. Favorite IDs are stored in localStorage and restored on page load. Empty favorites state appears when no quotes are saved.
